recipe.ghg_method: GWP100: IPCC AR6 for CO₂ (1), CH₄ (29.8) and N₂O (273). The single native CH₄ row mixes fossil-fuel extraction and refining (about 40%) with agriculture and waste (about 58%); it uses the fossil value, as MARIO's calc_ghg hybrid profile does, and 27 for the non-fossil share would lower the world total by about 1%. The source's HFC, PFC and SF₆ rows are empty, so F-gases are not covered. Emissions from unregistered waste, which the source reports separately from activity emissions, are added. Biogenic CO₂ excluded. The HIOT extension file reports 2.4% more fossil CO₂ for activities than the HSUT file; each table is used as published. Production accounts; direct final-demand emissions calculated separately and included once in Whole economy.
product_tax_rows: Taxes less subsidies on products purchased: Total
recipe.gdp_basis: GDP reconstructed with the source product-tax row
recipe.gdp_note: Value added plus the source's net product taxes, which EXIOBASE Hybrid publishes only as a row on activities. The release has no final-use tax row; as in monetary EXIOBASE 2011, whose final-use tax bridge is zero, none is added. Value added derives from an earlier monetary EXIOBASE vintage.
recipe.value_added_note: Sum of the explicitly listed value-added rows in the source; product taxes and balancing adjustments are excluded.
